verdict.rationale: Helicone is API-first. Its gateway is driven entirely through SDK calls, it documents a REST query API (curl to /v1/request/query) with a published OpenAPI spec, and it offers webhooks to automate workflows and Docker Compose self-hosting. That supports programmatic, non-UI use, but nothing documents a CLI, CI integration, or headless/CI workflow guidance specifically. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or eval gating in pipelines), headless-mode guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
